steps.note: brand fire v4 — official faces first, typed materialization second. Dry-run 2026-10-08 (s_82/s_83/s_84): the fresh form's select value is UNDEFINED until the dropdown is opened AND text is typed into the search input — only then Fusion Next resolves it to the official option object ({value:3246379,text:无品牌} for cat 201305805; the 50-entry dataSource is a hot-brand list that never contains the no-brand entry, and the async search cannot be fired synthetically). Precedence: (1) value already an object — exact id match (verified-default), dataSource id match (verified), 无品牌-family alias (verified-default-alias: the form's own default IS the official face); (2) materialize: open dropdown + type brand text (family probe types 无品牌, else the full text; one retype with a 6-char prefix at tick 10), poll 400ms for the value to resolve to an object — exact id (verified-typed), exact text (verified-typed-text: the official option for that text wins over a stale args id), or family alias; (3) dataSource arrival of args.brand_id (armed-fired); (4) at 88s the legacy direct fire of args (marked legacy-direct — the 10-04/10-07 items were built this way, server normalizes). The fired object is recorded on window.__brandUsed; step 13 binds THAT. Never fire an id no official face vouched for while a verified face is visible (#203). NOTE: Fusion materializes the typed text as a PENDING synthetic object {value:-1,text} first — the -1 is the custom-input marker, not an official option (dry-run s_85 tick 1 caught it; the engine resolved it by text, but recording -1 into __brandUsed would bind garbage into the submit). isOpt() rejects -1 everywhere; the poll waits the extra ~1s for the resolved official object.
engine catProp committed as {p-20000:{value:-1,text:...}} — the client validator's passing shape. If this never lands the instance was stale and the run is dead
